title: Baba Mujhe Zindaan Mein Rulwata Hai Zalim
body:
Haye sakina (s.a)-1
Souz.....
Qaid khane me sakina ko jo laae taqdeer ro ro kehne lagi hai hai mere baba shabbir kyun nahin dete khabar aaj huwi hoon mai asi aab meri tumhari hai mulaqaath aakhir nifs shab tak bhi yahan jena hai dushwar mera dekho ab aur ke bas aakhri deedaar mera.....
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
Sar tasht me rakkha huwa dikhla ta hai Zalim -1
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(1).Wo mujhko dara ta hai tamacho'n sitam se
Mai Jab Bhi Sada Deti HooN Ammu (a.s) Ko Bula De.
Naam Ammu (a.s) Ka Sun Kar Mere Tham Jaata Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(2).Gauhar Bhi Mere Cheene HaiN Kurta Bhi Jalaya.
Hai Qaid Bana Kar Mujhe Zindaan Mein Rakkha.
Aur BediyaaN Sajjad (a.s) Ko Phena Ta Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(3).Kyun Teri Sakina (s.a) Pe Sitam Hota Hai Aisa.
Ro Ro Ke TumheiN Jab Bhi Sada Deti HooN Baba (a.s).
Phir Durre Laga Ne Ko Chala Aata Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(4).Roti HooN To Rone NahiN Deta Mujhe Baba (a.s).
Na Ro'oN To Rone Ke Liye Kehta Hai Baba (a.s).
Zindaan Mein Kuch Aise Sitam Dhaata Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(5).Kya Beti Teri Ashk Bahane Ke Liye Hai.
Kya Beti Teri Sirf Satane Ke Liye Hai.
Kyun Mujh Ko Rula Kar Hi SukooN Paata Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(6).Baba (a.s) Yeh Mujhe Yaad NahiN Kab Se HooN Pyaasi.
Aansu To Mere Sookh Chuke Khoon Hai jaari.
Paani Ki Har Ik Boond Ko Tarsa Ta Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(7).Dadi (s.a) Ki Tarah MaiN Bhi HooN Ummat Ki Satayi.
Dadi (s.a) Ki Tarah Mujh Pe Bhi Chhayi Hai Zayeefi.
Haalat Pa Taras Meri NahiN Khaata Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
(8).Bas "Arsalaan" Mar Gayi Zindaan Mein Bachchi.
Kya Us Pe Guzar Ti Rahi Keh Bhi NahiN Paayi.
"Shahkaar" Bas Itna Kaha Tadh Paata Hai Zaalim.
Baba mujhe Zindaan me rulwata hai Zalim..-2
